aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the comparison but has a blocking error in the sub-3 process NG outcome.
issues: Changed factor is too generic; it should describe nonstandard HI-POXY storage temperature test vs normal.
Sub-3 process result is misread: total NG is 4/500 test vs 3/500 normal, not improved.
Process outcome should be worse or at least not aligned with the draft calculation.
Evidence omits the process header row and includes unrelated planning rows.
Workbook decision says can use despite mixed outcomes, which should be captured separately.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to nonstandard storage-temperature HI-POXY 9490BM test vs normal.
Recalculate sub-3 process bonding/F-PCB total NG as 0.8% test vs 0.6% normal.
Change process judgement to worse and cite rows Test!17, Test!19, and Test!20.
Keep function as comparable/similar or slight improved, citing Test!24, Test!26, and Test!28.
Keep drop reliability as no change/OK and include final decision row Test!35.
